svg.text: At n=36 a paired change is only detectable at 6 improvements with ZERO regressions (+16.7 pp).

svg.text: A smaller real effect would look like noise here. "No detectable change" is a statement about

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: this sample size, not about whether the model improved. The intervals overlap widely; that is the finding.
